fields.outcome: Publish agenthouse engineering 1.5.1 with consistent lowercase branding, complete Neri GmbH metadata, and production logo assets in the npm and plugin packages.
fields.scope: Brand text, package and plugin metadata, published logo assets, repository enrollment, release documentation, and the 1.5.1 GitHub/npm release. No runtime behavior or external marketplace approval is included.
fields.acceptance: All published AgentHouse display text is lowercase agenthouse; manifests identify Neri GmbH and agenthouse.org; every referenced logo exists in the archive; package, plugin, release, and test checks pass; v1.5.1 is pushed and the GitHub/npm release results are verified.
fields.decisions: Use a patch release because behavior is unchanged. Keep API identifiers such as AGENTHOUSE_HOME unchanged. Omit optional author email and terms URL. Use the existing GitHub Release workflow and npm trusted publishing.
fields.verification: Run the Codex plugin validator, npm run check, npm test, npm run test:browser, npm pack dry run, frozen agenthouse evaluation, and verify the GitHub release workflow plus npm registry version.
fields.changes: Brand assets and metadata are packaged; version and release documentation are synchronized to 1.5.1; the repository is enrolled in shared supervised mode.
fields.evidence: Codex plugin validation passed; npm release checks passed; 147 unit tests passed; the real-browser pilot passed; the frozen agenthouse pull-request profile passed; the npm dry run includes all five brand assets. Remote GitHub and npm publication remain pending.
fields.acceptanceEvidence: User explicitly requested enrollment followed by push and release. Technical acceptance remains subject to the recorded checks; this text is not a signed governance decision.
fields.releasePlan: Commit the reviewed 1.5.1 changes to main, push origin/main, publish GitHub release v1.5.1, and observe the Publish to npm workflow until completion.
fields.rollbackPlan: Use v1.5.0 as the source rollback point. If 1.5.1 is defective, publish a corrective patch and deprecate 1.5.1 on npm; npm versions are immutable. Remove or mark the GitHub release as appropriate only after preserving failure evidence.

criteria.expectation: Published brand text uses lowercase agenthouse while public API identifiers remain stable.
Package and plugin manifests identify Neri GmbH, agenthouse.org, and valid supported listing metadata.
All five production logo assets ship in the package and manifest references resolve.
GitHub v1.5.1 and npm @agenthouse/engineering 1.5.1 complete successfully.
